import re
import sys

values = {}

assignment_re = re.compile(r"\b([A-Za-z]+)\s*<-\s*(.*)", re.DOTALL)
constant_re = re.compile(r"\s*(\d+)\s*")
update_re = re.compile(
    r"\s*\(\s*([A-Za-z]+)\s*([+-])\s*(\d+)\s*\)\s*mod\s*(\d+)\s*"
)

for statement in sys.stdin.read().split(";"):
    match = assignment_re.search(statement)
    if not match:
        continue

    name, expression = match.groups()
    constant = constant_re.fullmatch(expression)
    if constant:
        values[name] = int(constant.group(1))
        continue

    update = update_re.fullmatch(expression)
    if update:
        variable, operator, amount, modulus = update.groups()
        amount = int(amount)
        if operator == "-":
            amount = -amount
        values[name] = (values[variable] + amount) % int(modulus)

print("; ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]}" for name in
                ("a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "h", "TMP")) + ";")
